scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w backend" "npm start -w Frontend"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n DEMO,WEB -c cyan,blue "npm run dev:demo -w backend" "npm start -w Frontend"

scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w Frontend
